# massdriver_stash_entry (Data Source)

Alpha: this data source can change or be removed at any time.

Reads one entry from the Massdriver stash of a project, environment, component, instance, or deployment. Fails when the entry does not exist or has expired. Stashes do not inherit: to read an environment's entry, set `environment`, not `instance`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a value that the database bundle wrote to its instance.
data "massdriver_stash_entry" "db_hostname" {
  instance = "ecomm-prod-db"
  key      = "db/hostname"
}

# Read a JSON value as an object.
data "massdriver_stash_entry" "release" {
  instance = "ecomm-prod-api"
  key      = "md/v1/release"
}

locals {
  db_hostname     = data.massdriver_stash_entry.db_hostname.value
  running_version = jsondecode(data.massdriver_stash_entry.release.data).version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The entry's key. Letters, digits, and the characters `_`, `.`, `/`, and `-`, up to 255 characters. Keys that start with `md/` are well-known keys. The server checks their values against a schema.

### Optional

- `component` (String) Identifier of the component whose stash holds the entry, such as `ecomm-db`. Set exactly one of `project`, `environment`, `component`, `instance`, or `deployment`.
- `deployment` (String) UUID of the deployment whose stash holds the entry. Inside a bundle deployment, this is the `MASSDRIVER_DEPLOYMENT_ID` environment variable. Set exactly one of `project`, `environment`, `component`, `instance`, or `deployment`.
- `environment` (String) Identifier of the environment whose stash holds the entry, such as `ecomm-prod`. Set exactly one of `project`, `environment`, `component`, `instance`, or `deployment`.
- `instance` (String) Identifier of the instance whose stash holds the entry, such as `ecomm-prod-db`. Set exactly one of `project`, `environment`, `component`, `instance`, or `deployment`.
- `project` (String) Identifier of the project whose stash holds the entry, such as `ecomm`. Set exactly one of `project`, `environment`, `component`, `instance`, or `deployment`.

### Read-Only

- `data` (String) The value of a `JSON` entry as a JSON object string, for use with `jsondecode`. Empty for a `TEXT` entry and for a sensitive entry.
- `expires_at` (String) When the entry expires, in RFC 3339 format. Empty when the entry does not expire.
- `format` (String) How the value is read: `TEXT` or `JSON`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `immutable` (Boolean) Whether the server refuses a second write to the key.
- `label` (String) The entry's label. Empty when it has none.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the entry is sensitive.
- `sensitive_value` (String, Sensitive) The value of a sensitive entry. Empty when the entry is not sensitive, or when the caller cannot read sensitive values. Reading it needs `stash:export` or a deployment token.
- `updated_at` (String) When the entry was last written, in RFC 3339 format.
- `value` (String) The entry's value. Empty when the entry is sensitive; see `sensitive_value`.
